target_customer: Unbanked and underbanked consumers and small merchants in Colombia
problem: Many Colombians lacked access to banking, so sending, saving and paying with a phone offered an alternative.
business_model: Mobile wallet and merchant payments with fees and interchange, plus insurance, cards and bill payments

founders.name: Andres Gutierrez
founders.background_notes: YC page calls him a 2-time founder from Colombia and lists board roles at El Tiempo, Compensar and Naranja Internet. Other co-founder names in aggregators conflict and are not recorded.

technical_complexity.rationale: Wallet, ledger and merchant integrations are standard fintech engineering, with compliance as the harder part.

defensibility.rationale: Wallets are easy to copy and bank backed rivals have distribution; defensibility rests on merchant relationships and licensing.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Bank backed wallets Nequi and Daviplata became the largest by users (about 10 and 13.8 million versus about 1 million for Tpaga in a 2022 article), so incumbents took the lead.

market_need_then: Colombia had a large unbanked population and growing smartphone use, and Superfinanciera was preparing oversight of electronic payment platforms (El Heraldo, June 2015).

branding.domain_note: Uses tpaga.co (Colombian domain); no purchase detail found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain consumer language about a bank in one app

branding.community_and_virality: No sourced evidence of merch or fan community.

brand_strength.rationale: Regional name recognition with about 1 million users, but no sourced brand led growth.

outcome_analysis: Tpaga survived and raised a 10 million dollar Series A in 2022 and sold a 30 percent stake to Banco Serfinanza in March 2026 for an undisclosed price. It remains far smaller than bank backed wallets, which stalled growth against better distributed rivals. The cited article states 15.1 million raised in total, more than the rounds recorded, so earlier funding is missing.
notes: LatamList states 15.1 million total raised, which exceeds the 12.2 million in recorded rounds; the gap is unresolved. Aggregators list totals from 12 to 25 million. The 2018 round stage is not labelled by the source, so it is other. A March 2026 report says Serfinanza bought 30 percent of Tpaga at an undisclosed price; not recorded as a round. No dated 2017 competitor sources were found; wallets Nequi and Daviplata launched around 2016 and 2017 per conflicting undated search results, so the list is empty.
